paper.correction_note: This benchmark's paper_id and citation were fabricated: DOI 10.1038/s41588-025-02283-2 (the identifier this benchmark was originally built from) is a 2-page Nature Genetics Research Briefing by Thomas M. Norman SUMMARIZING the real paper below — it is not a 'Joung' paper, and no author named Joung appears on either the briefing or the underlying research article. The invented title 'A transcription factor atlas of directed differentiation' with page range 828-838 belongs to a different, unrelated 2023 Cell paper (Joung, J. et al., cited only as reference #4 in Norman's briefing). GSE237056 and SCP2169, previously cited here as this paper's data, do not correspond to it either (GSE237056 has no resolvable record; SCP2169 is an unrelated human-tonsil snRNA-seq study). See Benchmarks/southard2024_comprehensive_transcription/ for the corrected, real reproduction, which verifies the paper's guide-library counts (10,979 guides; 1,836 TF targets) directly against the authors' own deposited data.
